limitations: Generic results and homonyms were rejected; source indexing is incomplete. No accessible source identified is not proof of absence. MathWorks LoadPathMATLAB is FE load-flow visualization, not fatigue MLP; FatPy repository was empty at inspection, and an Issue is not an implementation. Sports/physiological fatigue results were rejected.
